intent.goal: An adopter derives the set of specs whose acceptance it runs from the ledger, in one typed read, instead of maintaining it by hand.
nonGoals: Partitioning that set into CI groups
Running any acceptance, or reporting whether one passed

sectionHeadings: 207: The registry lists specs by implementation state and by whether verify would run anything
record.summary: `registry list` filters by lifecycle status only. Adopters that run every implemented spec's acceptance keep that set by hand, as a Makefile variable and as CI partitions validated against it, and resolve conflicts in it whenever two closures race. One adopter's hand list, compared on 2026-10-27 with what its corpus says, includes one spec still in progress and omits one complete spec that declares acceptance. This spec adds two filters that compose with `--status` and with `--ids-only`: `--implementation <state>`, over the frontmatter value, and `--has-acceptance`, true when `spec-spine verify <id>` would run at least one command, resolved the way `verify` resolves an amended block. The record gains `declaresAcceptance`, computed at compile, so the answer comes from the committed ledger like every other registry read.
record.title: The registry lists specs by implementation state and by whether verify would run anything
